source: Example rules for a fictional trading company (Contoso). Import with: pnpm cli rules:import --user owner@contoso.example --file docs/rules/example.json

rules.text: Spam and phishing never become tasks.
Mail about an order with orders@ in To or Cc: ignore it, the orders team has it.
Mail about an order without orders@ in To or Cc: remind me to forward it to orders@.
Orders: one line per order in the daily report.
Sales reports that also go to reports@: ignore them.
Invoices, statements and payment reminders that also go to accounting@: ignore them.
A service or repair request that nobody @contoso.example has answered yet is a task for me.
When a colleague @contoso.example has already replied, close the task and list it in the report instead.
Our own announcements (new arrivals, price lists) go in the report under “Updates”, not in the task list.
